collection.name: Showcase
collection.description: Made on the club's own GPUs. Every piece records its model, prompt and seed, so it can be made again exactly.

items.title: The neighbourhood
items.prompt: Isometric miniature diorama of a quiet neighbourhood at dusk, five small houses each with one softly glowing window, thin threads of warm light running between the rooftops like a constellation, tilt-shift photograph of a handmade paper and balsa model, deep indigo background, cosy and precise

items.title: Brass automaton
items.prompt: macro photograph of a small brass wind-up automaton figure standing on a dark green circuit board, shallow depth of field, warm rim light, dust motes

items.title: Garage rig
items.prompt: Risograph print, two-colour fluorescent pink and deep blue, a home garage workbench with a glowing desktop computer tower among bicycles and paint cans, visible grain and slight misregistration, flat shapes, generous paper margin

items.title: Great wave
items.prompt: Japanese ukiyo-e woodblock print of a great curling wave with tiny fishing boats beneath it, a small mountain on the horizon, muted indigo and cream ink, visible washi paper texture

items.title: Graphics card, in bloom
items.prompt: Vintage botanical illustration plate of a graphics card drawn as if it were a flowering plant, copper heat pipes as stems, fan blades as petals, delicate roots of gold traces, watercolour and fine ink on aged cream paper, scientific and tender

items.title: Cathedral of compute
items.prompt: A tall gothic stained glass window depicting a server rack as a saintly figure, rays of coloured light falling across a stone floor, deep cobalt, ruby and amber glass with thick lead lines, photographed from inside a dim chapel

items.title: Couriers
items.prompt: Stop-motion claymation still, three small round clay robots carrying glowing parcels along a miniature street between cardboard houses, visible fingerprints in the clay, soft studio lighting, shallow depth of field, cheerful

items.title: Sun in a jar
items.prompt: 1970s science fiction gouache painting, a living room at night where a small bright sun floats inside a glass jar on a coffee table, long shadows across shag carpet, a cat watching from the sofa, airbrushed gradients, muted teal and orange, painterly, no text, no letters, no title

items.title: Keeper's light
items.prompt: Thick impasto oil painting of a lighthouse on a storm-dark headland, its beam cutting through rain, heavy palette-knife strokes in violet, slate and bone white, sea spray, dramatic and quiet at once

items.title: Night market
items.prompt: Cinematic photograph of a rainy night market alley, paper lanterns reflected in puddles, a food stall with rising steam, one person under a transparent umbrella seen from behind, 35mm film, shallow depth of field, teal and amber

items.title: First Light (cover)
items.prompt: Square album cover, minimal geometric poster design, a pale sun rising behind layered paper-cut hills in peach, sand and soft blue, grainy print texture, no text, no letters

items.title: Tailnet Drive (cover)
items.prompt: Square album cover, retro synthwave illustration, an empty coastal highway at night seen from the driver's seat, neon magenta horizon line, palm silhouettes, stars, chrome reflections, no text, no letters

items.title: Porch Light (cover)
items.prompt: Square album cover, warm watercolour painting of a wooden porch at dusk with one hanging lamp lit, moths around it, an acoustic guitar leaning on a chair, fields beyond, soft paper bleed, no text, no letters

items.title: First Light
items.prompt: ambient neoclassical, felt piano, slow warm strings, soft tape hiss, hopeful, 70 bpm, instrumental

items.title: Tailnet Drive
items.prompt: synthwave, driving analog bass, gated drums, bright arpeggiated synth lead, night drive, 110 bpm, instrumental

items.title: Porch Light
items.prompt: indie folk, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, soft brushed drums, warm female vocal, close harmonies, intimate, 92 bpm
items.lyrics:
[verse]
Left the porch light on for you
Moths are writing in the blue
Every house along the lane
Hums a little, just the same

[chorus]
Send it down the wire to me
I'll send it back by morning
What we have, we have to share
A little light, a little warning

[verse]
Someone's kettle, someone's fan
Someone's doing what they can
All these rooms, a single sky
Passing notes as they go by

[chorus]
Send it down the wire to me
I'll send it back by morning
What we have, we have to share
A little light, a little warning

items.title: Welcome to the club
items.prompt: Welcome to inference club. Every picture, song and voice on this page, including this one, was made on a graphics card in somebody's house.

items.title: Four lines about a porch light
items.prompt: Write a four-line poem about a porch light left on for a neighbour. No title.
items.text:
A steady glow against the night,
A quiet watch from wood and paint.
It signals safety, soft and bright,
For neighbours walking home late.
